body: Worker trap (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-29, my own void run test-0240a29a on w-c205 slice A). TermAl's Rust test FILES are mounted under DIFFERENT module names, via #[path] and include! inside larger modules. For example, src/tests/engram_control_transport.rs is tests::engram_host_adapter::control_transport::, and engram_begin_replay.rs is …::admission_retry::begin_replay::. A focused `cargo test --bin termal -- <file names>` therefore matches nothing, exits 0 and reports "running 0 tests … N filtered out". BEFORE asking for a Cargo GO, list the selection: run `cargo test --bin termal -- --list <filters>` and count the `: test$` lines, then propose module-path filters such as ::control_transport::. AFTER every focused run, check that the log's `test result` line shows passed > 0; a 0-test pass is void, not evidence.
